summary: Provides AST-based code analysis capabilities, including functions to analyze Python statements and expressions as well as utilities for building symbol indexes.
responsibilities: Provides functions to analyze statements, expressions, tuples, slices, sets, arrays, and dictionaries using Abstract Syntax Trees.
Builds class and function indexes and AST indexes from source code symbols.
relationships: Statement analysis and symbol indexing are components of AST-based code analysis.
design_decisions: Organizes analysis routines into specialized modules for statements, expressions, and symbols.
